historical_conclusion: Actual water admixture in air, identity as rarefied water, virtual elemental presence and future transformation are distinct historical propositions. The sources do not establish the exact literal proposition aqueous vapour physically contains water; they also do not license rejecting it simply because vapour is not a vessel.
